subject: Web Development
title: Framework Lock-In
description: A quick, practical guide to Framework Lock-In.

hook.text: Once you build a large app in a framework, switching to another is nearly impossible.

buildup.text: Framework-specific patterns, components, and plugins create deep dependencies.

discovery.text: Rewrites are expensive. Many companies run legacy framework code for years beyond its prime.

twist.text: Web standards like Web Components promise escape hatches, but adoption remains slow.

climax.text: Lock-in is the hidden cost every team pays after choosing the shiny framework of the year.

punchline.text: Today's best choice is tomorrow's legacy code.

quiz.question: Why is framework migration so difficult?
